name: kas Yocto build orchestrator
description: Installs the kas (Siemens) build automation tool for Yocto/bitbake projects. Pip-installs a pinned kas release and ships a shell wrapper that drives common build steps (init, build, shell, cleansstate) using project-scoped sstate-cache and downloads directories.

version.description: kas version pinned for pip install. Use '5.2' (current as of Feb 2026) for reproducible builds; use 'latest' to track upstream (not recommended for CI).

menu_file.description: Default kas configuration YAML the wrapper script targets when no explicit file is provided. Resolved relative to KAS_MENU_DIR (the project workspace by default).
